# CodeNative

CodeNative is India's First Telugu Coding Learning Platform. It is a free, AI-powered platform designed to teach programming concepts to native Telugu speakers through structured interactive lessons, a built-in compiler, and AI doubts support.

## Interactive Coding Courses
- [C Programming in Telugu](https://codenative.co.in/c.html) - Structured C language basics, pointers, and memory management.
- [Java Programming in Telugu](https://codenative.co.in/java.html) - Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles, classes, and inheritance.
- [Python Programming in Telugu](https://codenative.co.in/python.html) - Python syntax, logic building, data structures, and scripting.
- [JavaScript in Telugu](https://codenative.co.in/js.html) - Modern interactive programming, DOM manipulation, and asynchronous JS.
- [Web Development in Telugu](https://codenative.co.in/web.html) - HTML5 structures and CSS styling foundations.

## Learning Tools & Navigation
- [Online Compiler](https://codenative.co.in/compiler.html) - Practice and run code directly in the browser.
- [Learning Roadmap](https://codenative.co.in/roadmap.html) - Structured guide mapping the journey to becoming a developer.
- [AI Doubt Solver](https://codenative.co.in/doubts) - Ask coding doubts and get solutions in Telugu powered by AI.
- [User Dashboard](https://codenative.co.in/dashboard) - Track learning progress, streaks, assignments, and tasks.
- [Referral Center](https://codenative.co.in/referrals) - Refer friends and track referral program rewards.
- [Sign In / Register](https://codenative.co.in/signin.html) - Access your personalized learning profile.
